properties.name: OAKEY MTN. OHV TRAILHEAD
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: The thrill of driving off-road vehicles over mountainous terrain and trail systems equals the Oakey Mountain OHV recreation area. This site near Lake Burton and Lake Rabun offers two-way trails that are open to OHVs with less than a 48-inch axle width and offers terrain from intermediate to rocky and steep. All OHV trails on the national forest close during wet conditions when trail use can cause damage to trails and erosion into nearby streams.  Please contact the Chattooga River Ranger District for the latest information on trail availability due to frequent weather contingencies. 706-754-6221 or check the website www.fs.usda.gov/conf
details.feeDescription:
Day Use:
$5 per operator per day
details.hours: Day use only: open sunrise to sunset
details.directions: From Clayton, GA take US-76 west for 7.0 miles.Turn left onto Charlie Mtn. Road and drive 3.6 miles. Turn right onto Bridge Creek Road and go 2.0 miles. Turn right onto Burton Dam Rd. and go 1.6 miles.  Turn left onto Forest Service Road 161 and arrive at Oakey Mtn. OHV trailhead.

properties.name: RICE CAMP TRAILHEAD
properties.publicUse: USFS recreation site; verify current season, fees, access and closures.

details.description: This 6-8 vehicle parking area provides access to three Cohutta Wilderness trails;  Rice Camp, Hickory Ridge, and East Cowpen. High clearance vehicles are recommended as there are two creeks that must be forded on the access road leading to the trailhead.
details.feeDescription: No fees are required for this site
details.hours: Open 24 hours/day
details.directions: Take I-75 north to Exit #293, Hwy 411, Chatsworth/White.  Go north on Hwy 411 through Chatsworth. At the Hardee's, continue on Hwy 411 north about 12.3 miles to Cisco. Turn right at the Cisco Baptist Church onto Old GA Highway 2 and drive about 8.1 miles.  Turn right onto Forest Road 51 (sign here that says Rice Camp, East Cowpen, Hickory Creek, Horseshoe Bend) and go 2.8 miles to the Horseshoe Bend Trailhead on the left, a big open area.  To reach the Rice Camp/East Cowpen/Hickory Creek Trailhead, continue straight on Forest Road 51 another 2.1 miles to the end of the road at the trailheads.  NOTE:  There are 2 stream fords on Forest Road 51 which may not be passable with smaller cars.  Do not stop in the middle of the streams but continue moving at a slow but steady speed.  After heavy rainfall, the stream fords will rise, and crossing is not recommended.

details.description: The Davenport Mountain OHV Trail is 5.9 miles in length. The trails are suitable for motorcycles and ATVs. This trail loops around Davenport Mountain with some moderate grades, and offers views of Nottely Lake. This trail is approximately 12.0 miles west of Blairsville, GA.
